scope: Independent original GLB actor and evaluated runtime adapter triangle-surface sampling in actual mounted React/R3F components with no-op renderer. Offline exports are evaluated runtime meshes, not browser screenshots.
limitations: Discrete time samples, not a continuous collision certificate.
Foot region is original sculpture triangles clipped at sculpture minY + 0.32 * pawn scale, excluding the ownership pedestal.
Positive triangle intersections prove contact of sampled surfaces; lack of intersection does not exclude containment or between-sample collision.

Reference geometry is the initial displayed pose, used to prevent a fall masking an early miss. Actual currently evaluated body surfaces are separately checked, including bystander animation and falls.
No scenery, floor, other machines, lights or audience collision certificate.
No browser/GPU pixel verification in this harness.
The roster-only mode projects each selectable model into the same confirmed trip presentation fixture; it is geometry coverage, not a test of every role’s rule-trigger conditions.
The moving-clock pause stress probe is not production: only the frozen shared PresentationClock is the supported phase guarantee.
